propositions: When structured parsing exhausts OUTPUT_RETRIES in the prompted reask loop of _pai_structured, if llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is configured, the raw reply text along with model id and contract name must be written to a timestamped artifact file before the terminal parse error is raised.

The new llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir config key is a str|None field on LLMConfig resolved via _llm_str in from_env using the REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR environment variable, following the standard CLI > env > file > default precedence.

Artifact writing is best-effort and local-only: unset key (default None) preserves byte-for-byte current behavior; I/O errors never mask the original parse error; the directory is created if absent; at most 20 artifacts per directory are retained by mtime-based rotation.
The feature is documented in docs/config.md alongside other llm.* keys with default, env alias, and rotation behavior specified.
